name: com.silkvin/agent-door
title: SilkVin — wholesale parts for Chinese cars
description: Wholesale parts for Chinese cars (UAE): search by OE number, model or part; request quotes.

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Search SilkVin's wholesale catalogue of parts for Chinese vehicle brands (Chery, Omoda, Jaecoo, Jetour, Exeed, Haval/GWM, MG, Changan, BYD) by OE number, model, brand or part name. Returns catalogue lines (models, years, OE numbers, page) and core-range references. No prices are published. Wholesale only.

tools.name: lookup_oe
tools.description: Find which SilkVin catalogue line or core-range reference carries an OE (or aftermarket) part number. Dashes, spaces and dots are ignored.

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: Full detail of one catalogue line by id: models, years, engine, OE numbers, aftermarket equivalents with sources, measurements, what to send to get it quoted, typical markets and page.

tools.name: get_terms
tools.description: Who SilkVin sells to, quality levels, warranty, payment, availability, what is not supplied, compliance and contacts.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a request for quotation to SilkVin on behalf of a trade buyer (importer, distributor, wholesaler, parts store or workshop network). Lines can be OE numbers, catalogue line ids or free-text parts, with estimated quantities. Creates a case reviewed by a person; the written quote (price, Incoterm, lead time) follows by e-mail, normally within 48 working hours. Nothing is binding. It registers the buyer's contact details with SilkVin.

business_type.description: distributor/importer, reexporter, retailer (parts store or chain), workshop (network), other trade buyer
